drhp.business: Yudiz Solutions operates in the Information Technology services and consulting sector, with expertise across Enterprise Software, Mobile Applications, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Game Development, Blockchain Technologies, FinTech and digital products. The Company operates within a single reportable IT segment, serving customers across FinTech, digital products, Gaming and other technology development activities, and is progressively strengthening its focus on developing and commercializing proprietary technology products alongside its established IT services business.
drhp.expansion: The Company incorporated Yudiz IT Solutions L.L.C. as a wholly-owned subsidiary in Dubai on September 12, 2025, to undertake IT services and strengthen market access in the GCC region. The Board has, in principle, approved acquiring the remaining 49% stake in Insightly Dataworks Private Limited, a process at an advanced stage, after which it would become a wholly owned subsidiary. Unutilised IPO proceeds were redirected via a Postal Ballot special resolution toward strategic investments in eligible, promising technology-focused entities, and the entire amount was utilised during FY 2025-26.

sk.overview: Broadcasting and streaming is a segment of the global media & entertainment (M&E) industry undergoing a structural shift to a 'new video economy' - the transition from traditional cable/DTH to internet-delivered video (OTT, FAST, CTV). The shift is characterised by fragmentation of viewership, globalisation of content, and a move to ad-supported models, and it is driving M&E companies to adopt cloud-native, purpose-built streaming-video software for production, preparation, distribution and monetization. demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Global technology industry transformation driven by increasing adoption of Artificial Intelligence, automation, cloud technologies, digital platforms and data-driven solutions.
- Industry shift from traditional project-based technology services towards product-led, platform-based and technology-enabled business models.
- Gaming and digital entertainment sectors evolving with increasing digital consumption and adoption of mobile and online platforms.
- FinTech experiencing technology-led transformation through digital payments, automation, data analytics and AI-enabled solutions.
- Following the significant correction witnessed across global technology markets after the Company's IPO in 2023, the Company remains focused on strengthening its fundamentals and improving operational efficiency.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: The Company incorporated Yudiz IT Solutions L.L.C. as a wholly-owned subsidiary in Dubai on September 12, 2025, to undertake IT services and strengthen market access in the GCC region. The Board has, in principle, approved acquiring the remaining 49% stake in Insightly Dataworks Private Limited, a process at an advanced stage, after which it would become a wholly owned subsidiary. Unutilised IPO proceeds were redirected via a Postal Ballot special resolution toward strategic investments in eligible, promising technology-focused entities, and the entire amount was utilised during FY 2025-26.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- May alter traditional software development and technology delivery models and requires continuous investment in technology, talent and infrastructure; the Company must continuously upgrade capabilities and adapt its workforce.
- Competition from established players and new technology-focused companies may place pressure on pricing, margins and market share.
- These segments may be affected by regulatory developments and changes in government policies; changes in Gaming-industry regulations may affect business opportunities and operating conditions.
- Macroeconomic conditions, fluctuations in global IT spending, international trade policies, tariffs, geopolitical developments and changes in customer technology budgets may impact demand for technology services and products.
- Product investments may require time and resources before generating meaningful commercial returns, and market acceptance depends on customer requirements, competitive offerings and the Company's ability to continuously enhance its products.
- Rapid technological change requires continuous investment in skills, infrastructure, research and development to keep pace with evolving delivery models.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Gradual transition towards a more product-led technology business, developing and commercializing proprietary products and technology platforms alongside the existing IT services business.
- Leverage capabilities across AI/ML, FinTech, Gaming, Blockchain and digital technologies to develop scalable products and platforms.
- Entry into FinTech and payment services (payment gateway, aggregation, collection, transaction routing, electronic fund transfer via UPI/NEFT/RTGS) following alteration of the Main Objects Clause.
- Expand geographical reach through operations in the GCC region via the Dubai subsidiary.
- Evaluate suitable acquisition and partnership opportunities aligned with long-term objectives.
- Redirected unutilised IPO proceeds toward strategic investments in eligible and promising technology-focused entities.
